captions.text: Back on Searches, open the search you just made.
Preview shows what your filters keep, without using any AI.
It's a quick way to check your settings.
It shows how many postings it found, how many passed your filters, and why the rest were left out.
When it looks right, click run search now.
The AI reads each job that passed, and scores it against your profile.
With local AI, this takes a few minutes, depending on your computer.
You can keep using the app while it runs.
The new jobs are waiting in your Review List.
